title: Connection evidence
description: The connections resolution context: the acquisition each connection parameter of one deployment reached, keyed by parameter, with each SELECTED acquisition’s persisted selection (blueprint §5.3). Shape only: a context this schema rejects is malformed evidence, ERR_INVALID_RESOLUTION_CONTEXT, and one it accepts must still satisfy BP-CONNECTION-002.
$comment: Generated by `task docs` (tools/src/render/protocols.ts) from component’s protocol registry, docs/adr/0045. Do not edit by hand.

parameters.description: Connection parameter name → what acquisition reached for it.

ConnectionAcquisition.description: What acquisition reached for one connection parameter: its status, and for a SELECTED one the persisted selection (blueprint §5.3, BP-CONNECTION-002).

status.description: The acquisition status, one row of the BP-CONNECTION-002 outcome table.

persisted.description: The selection and its scoped credential are persisted (BP-CONNECTION-003).

ConnectionSelection.description: One immutable, authorized selection for one deployment and connection parameter (blueprint §5.3).

deployment.description: The deployment the selection was acquired for.

parameter.description: The connection parameter the selection was acquired for.

selectionKind.description: MANAGED, chosen by the organization, or USER, supplied by the deployer.

provisioning.description: For a MANAGED selection only: access to a shared service, or a service provisioned for this deployment.

costOwner.description: Who pays for the selected service.

views.description: One view per protocol the selected service speaks, keyed by protocol.

ConnectionRequest.description: The acquisition request the selection answers, not the provider selected: the parameter’s from, and the policy that answered it.

ConnectionCredential.description: The one scoped credential of the selection. Absent only for a server that requires no authentication.

value.description: The value of each view's credential member: apiKey for OPENAI_CHAT_COMPLETIONS, apiKey for ANTHROPIC_MESSAGES, password for POSTGRES, password for REDIS, secretAccessKey for S3.

permittedBaseURLs.description: The URLs the locator of an HTTP-based view may take. Required by blueprint §5.3 when a view is of an HTTP-based protocol.

OpenaiChatCompletionsView.description: A OPENAI_CHAT_COMPLETIONS view: the members a view of the protocol carries (openai-chat-completions.json). It never carries the credential, a secret or a derived member.

baseURL.description: HTTPS base URL a client sends Chat Completions requests to.

model.description: Model the client names in each request.

capabilities.description: The capabilities the selected service supports.

AnthropicMessagesView.description: A ANTHROPIC_MESSAGES view: the members a view of the protocol carries (anthropic-messages.json). It never carries the credential, a secret or a derived member.

baseURL.description: HTTPS base URL a client sends Messages requests to.

model.description: Model the client names in each request.

capabilities.description: The capabilities the selected service supports.

PostgresView.description: A POSTGRES view: the members a view of the protocol carries (postgres.json). It never carries the credential, a secret or a derived member.

host.description: DNS name, IPv4 address, or IPv6 address without brackets, of the server; never with a port.

sslMode.description: PostgreSQL's sslmode, which fixes how the client uses TLS.

RedisView.description: A REDIS view: the members a view of the protocol carries (redis.json). It never carries the credential, a secret or a derived member.

host.description: DNS name, IPv4 address, or IPv6 address without brackets, of the server; never with a port.

username.description: User the client authenticates as; without it, the server's default user.

S3View.description: A S3 view: the members a view of the protocol carries (s3.json). It never carries the credential, a secret or a derived member.

endpointURL.description: HTTPS service URL a client sends requests to, never including the bucket.

pathStyle.description: Whether the client puts the bucket in the path rather than the hostname.
